title: server-audit findings.json
description: The machine-readable twin of report.md, written in every full audit next to it (mode 600) and checked with `python3 -I scripts/validate_findings.py <run>/findings.json` before the chat summary. Documentation only: the validator implements these rules by hand, no JSON Schema library is used. No secret values and no fingerprints (fp=, xfp=) anywhere; masked forms such as <REDACTED> are fine.

id.description: unique across findings and rejected; the report's # number

area.description: the section of references/checks.md: 1 exposure · 2 proxy · 3 ssh · 4 users · 5 secrets · 6 services · 7 updates · 8 tls · 9 backups · 10 detection · 11 ai-agents · 12 operator (things the host cannot see) · 13 disk · 14 dns-mail · 15 drift · 16 fleet

path.description: attack path letter; a path joins two or more findings

adjust_reason.description: required when severity is one level off the reachability × impact table (SKILL.md step 6); two or more levels off is never valid

confirm_by.description: required when confidence is inferred or verified-partial: what would confirm it

verifier.description: null until an independent verifier has looked at the finding

rejected.description: candidates dropped as false positives, so the drop is explicit (SKILL.md step 4)

backup_ladder.description: true / false / null (unknown). restore_tested is true only if a finding or evidence entry mentions a restore.

not_checked.description: the report's 'Not checked / needs the operator' items
